sentences.text: 1.  This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., 1973 seeking quashing of FIR no. 0560/2021 dated 30.10.2021 under Section 498A IPC, 1860, registered at Police Station Vasant Kunj and the proceedings emanating therefrom, on the grounds of settlement between the parties.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that under the aegis of the Counselling Cell in Family Courts at Patiala House Court the disputes between the parties vide the settlement deed recorded on 02.08.2022.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the joint statement of the parties before the Family Court rendered vide This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/10/2023 at 02:46:37 the judgment of the Family Court passed under Section 13 (b)(1) of HMA Act, 1955 is placed along with additional list of documents before this Court.

sentences.text:
According to the terms of the settlement property bearing no.5582/18,
Street No.3, Govind Nagar, New Shimlapuri, Ludhiana-141003 has been transferred in the name of respondent no.2 and both children.
5. Respondent no.2 is present in person and submits that the sum of Rs.75 lacs has already been received by her in the interregnum.
She also submits that the aforesaid property stands transferred in her name and the children in terms of the settlement.
She also submits that she does not have any further claims nor any dispute against the petitioner.
She confirms that she has no objection if the present FIR and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
6. Investigating Officer is present in person and identifies the parties who are present in Court.
7. This Court has perused the terms of settlement agreement and they appear to be lawful.
The parties are bound by the terms of the settlement.

8. After observing that the disputes are arising from matrimonial ties, this Court is of the considered opinion that no purpose would be served in continuing with the FIR in question and the further criminal
